title: Virtues action manifest
description: Schema for actions/<name>/manifest.toml. The folder name supplies id_prefix as `action_<folder>` if not set explicitly. See actions/AUTHORING.md for the user-facing guide.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what this action does.

owner.description: system: shipped with Virtues; reconcile overwrites declarative fields. user: authored by user/LLM; INSERT-OR-IGNORE — preserved after first seed.

runtime.description: function: fork-per-trigger CLI (stdin/stdout JSON). service: long-running supervised HTTP server. view: pure Svelte component, no server-side execution.

command.description: Argv to spawn (function = subprocess, service = supervised daemon). A bare command[0] resolves to a Cargo-built action binary under target/{debug,release}; anything else runs via PATH. Examples: ["ios_healthkit"], ["python3", "main.py"], ["node", "server.js"], ["./build/handler"].

triggers.description: What can fire this action. webhook requires per_credential=true. view-runtime actions should set [] (never invoked server-side).

default_cron.description: Cron expression (sec min hour dom month dow), e.g. "0 0 7 * * *" for 7am daily. Seeds cron_schedule on first reconcile; user edits via UI win after. Legacy alias of `schedule`.

default_enabled.description: Whether this action is enabled when first seeded.

per_credential.description: When true, fan out one app_actions row per active credential of `source.id`. Required for webhook-triggered actions.

source.description: Required when per_credential=true. Match credentials by source_id.

agent.description: Prompt for an LLM-driven action. When set with no command, the action runs as an agent loop (no subprocess).

condition.description: SQL expression evaluated before each run; if false, run is skipped silently. Used to gate hourly-cron-but-only-fire-once-a-day actions.

id_prefix.description: Override the auto-derived `action_<folder>` id. Rare — change only if migrating an existing action that needs a stable id.

config.description: Free-form config that flows into app_actions.config JSON. Notable: [config.view] name = "<applet>" for view-runtime actions; [config.service] health_path / mem_mb for service-runtime actions; [config.image_url] for custom card hero illustrations.

name.description: Folder under apps/web/src/lib/applets/<name>/ holding Card.svelte / Detail.svelte for this action.

health_path.description: Path the supervisor GETs to confirm service readiness.

mem_mb.description: Soft RSS cap (macOS-only watchdog). Absent on Linux for v1.

image_url.description: Optional path/URL for the TemplateCard hero illustration (e.g. /templates/morning-examen.png).

schedule.description: Cron seed (6-field, seconds first, box-local timezone) for the live cron_schedule value. Canonical spelling; default_cron is the legacy alias.

until.description: Lifecycle: absent = forever; 'once' = archive after first successful run; any other value = SQL boolean checked after each success, archive when true.

supervise.description: Command applets: run as a long-lived supervised service instead of fork-per-trigger (replaces runtime='service').

examples.name: Morning Examen
examples.agent: You are the user's morning reflection companion. ...

examples.name: iOS HealthKit
examples.description: Ingest HealthKit metrics from a paired iPhone.
